title: Adjectives (Instrumental Case)
description: Adjective endings in the instrumental case
intro: The instrumental case (with, by means of) requires specific adjective endings. Masculine and neuter take -ым/-им (hard/soft). Feminine takes -ой/-ей (same as dative/genitive/prepositional!). Plural takes -ыми/-ими. The instrumental is used with prepositions like с (with), за (behind), над (above), под (below), and перед (in front of), as well as for professions and comparisons.
rules: The instrumental is used with с (with), за (behind), над (above), под (under), между (between), and перед (in front of).
Professions and roles use instrumental without a preposition: Он работает врачом (He works as a doctor).
Adjectives expressing satisfaction or pride take instrumental: доволен результатом, горжусь дочерью.
Plural instrumental adjectives (-ыми/-ими) are the longest adjective forms in Russian — they stand out and are easy to recognize.
examples: Я говорю с новым другом. (I am talking with my new friend.), masc
Она гуляет с младшей сестрой. (She walks with her younger sister.), fem
Мы работаем с хорошими людьми. (We work with good people.), plural
Он стал известным писателем. (He became a famous writer.), masc

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Instrumental adjective endings: masc -ым, fem -ой, pl -ыми
hints: С (with) requires instrumental case. Мёд is masculine. What ending does a masculine adjective take in instrumental?
С (with) requires instrumental. Подруга is feminine. Feminine instrumental ending: -ой or -ым?
С (with) requires instrumental. Людьми is plural. Plural instrumental ending: -ыми or -ых?
Профессия (profession) uses instrumental without preposition. Врач is masculine.
Под (under) requires instrumental. Стол is masculine. Use the masculine instrumental ending.
explanations: С requires instrumental. Masculine: вкусный → вкусным (ending -ым).
С requires instrumental. Feminine: старая → старой (ending -ой).
С requires instrumental. Plural: хорошие → хорошими (ending -ими).
Professions use instrumental: хороший → хорошим врачом.
Под requires instrumental. Masculine: большой → большим (ending -им).
